description: Système de routes (v 1993) des routes régionales flamandes is a dataset listed in data.gov.be, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Agentschap Wegen en Verkeer. The route system contains the Flemish Regional Roads (without accesses and exits to the motorways). The system is built in Arc/Info based on Teleatlas' BELNET-10. Coverage: Agentschap Wegen en Verkeer. The portal shows the English title as "Route system (v 1993) of the Flemish regional roads" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Agentschap Wegen en Verkeer. Its keywords include ROUTE93, MOBILITEITSRELEVANTE, WEGNUMMER, WEGTYPE, TELEATLAS, VLAAMSE GEWESTWEGEN. The listing shows 1993-01-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-be.
